projects.title: Projects & Achievements
projects.stringempty.title: StringEmpty
projects.stringempty.desc: Design of a production monorepo centralizing my production projects, including Wendigo, an interactive game platform. The project is built on a Homelab GitOps architecture where the repository is the single source of truth. A build server, through the CI/CD pipeline, automatically compiles the code and continuously deploys updates to a second server handling Kubernetes orchestration, ensuring full end-to-end automation.
projects.wendigo.title: Wendigo
projects.wendigo.desc: Design of a real-time interactive game platform (a multiplayer party game). The project is built on a robust client-server architecture with an authoritative Go backend (WebSockets, Redis, PostgreSQL), a React frontend, OIDC authentication (Authentik), all packaged in a single Docker image. The stack is orchestrated in Kubernetes with dynamic pod scaling based on player demand via a load balancer.
projects.crystal.title: Crystal ERP
projects.crystal.desc: Full Stack development of an ERP management application (React 19, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core 9, PostgreSQL). Configured infrastructure using Docker, Nginx, and Azure Pipelines. Designed secure API endpoints (JWT/CASL) and developed automated logic for real-time attendance tracking.
projects.castle.title: Castle of SFML — 3D Engine & Game
projects.castle.desc: Developed a 3D rendering engine (Raycaster) and survival game in C# (.NET 6). Implemented BFS pathfinding AI and designed a modular architecture with automated testing (xUnit, CI/CD).
